### Plotting Code

Sector paths and colours come from the source PDF; all printed counts are transcribed exactly. The original sector angles are preserved rather than recalculated from those counts. Labels are editable plotting text; 19 small original pictograms remain embedded transparent raster images and seven retain their source vector paths. Font metrics and icon rendering may differ slightly. The repeated inner modality labels are the original five-colour key.

```python
"""LOKI Figure 2 self-contained chart reconstruction, not author source.
Sector geometry and palette are recovered from PDF p.4 rather than recomputed
from counts: the original angles are not a quantitative encoding of the printed
counts. All visible numerical annotations are exact transcriptions. Text is
recreated with editable Matplotlib labels. Nineteen original small pictograms
are embedded transparent raster objects; the seven other icons retain native
source vector paths. No whole-figure or whole-panel raster is embedded.
Fonts and tiny pictogram antialiasing can differ from the original PDF.
"""

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.path import Path
from matplotlib.patches import PathPatch
from matplotlib.transforms import Affine2D

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14.21,6.80),dpi=100,facecolor="white")
ax=fig.add_axes([0,0,1,1])
ax.set_xlim(133,474);ax.set_ylim(425,262);ax.set_aspect("equal");ax.axis("off")
# Exact source cubic sectors, including the original inner overlays/white rims.
for q in DATA["sectors"]:
    ax.add_patch(PathPatch(Path(np.array(q["vertices"]),q["codes"]),
        facecolor=q["color"],edgecolor="white",linewidth=q["linewidth"]*3,
        capstyle="butt",joinstyle="miter",zorder=1))

def radial_label(rec,right=False):
    angle=rec["angle"];rad=np.deg2rad(angle);cx,cy=rec["center"]
    radius=58.0 if right else 55.7
    if not right and rec["label"]=="Scientific\nPapers":radius=53.5
    if not right and rec["label"]=="Ancient\nChinese":radius=52.5
    if not right and "Environmental"in rec["label"]:radius=54.0
    x,y=cx+radius*np.cos(rad),cy-radius*np.sin(rad)
    if not right and rec["label"]=="NeRF-based":x,y=175.8,391.4
    rotation=angle if -90<=angle<=90 else angle+180
    label=rec["label"]
    if not right and label=="NeRF-based":label="NeRF-\nbased"
    if right:label+= "\n"+r"$\mathit{"+str(rec["count"])+"}$"
    fs=15.4 if right else 16.2
    if not right and "Environmental"in label:fs=15.1
    if not right and "Scientific"in label:fs=15.75
    if not right and "NeRF-"in label:fs=14.6
    if right and "Detail Selection"in label:fs=14.3
    ax.text(x,y,label,rotation=rotation,rotation_mode="anchor",
            ha="center",va="center",fontsize=fs,linespacing=1.04,
            color="black",zorder=3)

for q in DATA["left_outer"]:radial_label(q)
for q in DATA["right_outer"]:radial_label(q,True)

# The five colours are keyed by the two native inner sets of modality labels.
for q in DATA["inner_labels"]:
    ax.text(q["x"],q["y"],q["text"],ha="center",va="center",
            fontsize=q["size"]*3,fontweight="bold",fontfamily="Arial",zorder=4)
for q in DATA["inner_counts"]:
    ax.text(q["x"],q["y"],q["text"],ha="center",va="center",
            fontsize=15.75,fontstyle="italic",zorder=4)

# Local pictograms remain source images. Their positions and bytes are embedded
# so this code does not depend on a private path, a network or an external PNG.
for q in DATA["icons"]:
    im=plt.imread(io.BytesIO(base64.b64decode(q["png_base64"])))
    transform=Affine2D.from_values(*q["transform"])+ax.transData
    ax.imshow(im,extent=(0,1,1,0),transform=transform,interpolation="lanczos",zorder=5)
for q in DATA["icon_paths"]:
    ax.add_patch(PathPatch(Path(np.array(q["vertices"]),q["codes"]),facecolor=q["color"],edgecolor="none",zorder=5))

fig.savefig("loki_modality_and_question_distributions.png",dpi=150)
fig.savefig("loki_modality_and_question_distributions.svg")
plt.show()
```

### Plotting Code

Note: The following code is an approximate visual reconstruction based on the provided figure. The seven bar labels are exact transcriptions from Figure 5(b). NBI square areas/signs and the unlabelled Human-minus-GPT-4o curve are digitized estimates, not experimental raw data. Radar accuracies come from Table 2 (PDF p.8), with audio cross-checked against Table 16 (p.36); division by each axis's Human baseline is an inferred visual normalization. Unsupported modalities are omitted, not assigned zero. The reference's broken y-axis and separated audio sector are reproduced as layout features.

```python
"""LOKI Figure 5: self-contained visual reconstruction (not author plotting source).

Data provenance:
* Seven bar labels are transcribed exactly from the approved Figure 5(b).
* The Human-minus-GPT-4o line is digitized approximately from unlabelled points.
* NBI values are estimated from the areas/signs of coloured matrix squares.
  Their sampled source colours are embedded separately for faithful appearance.
* Radar accuracy values are transcribed from Table 2 (paper PDF p.8), with audio
  cross-checked against Table 16 (p.36). Per-axis division by the Human row is
  an inferred visual normalization that matches the relative radar, not a claim
  to recover the authors' hidden plotting arrays. Missing modalities are omitted.
The estimated quantities are not experimental raw data.
"""
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle, Polygon, Patch, Arc
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap, Normalize
from matplotlib.cm import ScalarMappable

plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["Times New Roman", "DejaVu Serif"],
    "font.size": 13,
    "axes.linewidth": 0.65,
    "mathtext.fontset": "stix",
    "savefig.facecolor": "white",
})
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16.68, 5.18), dpi=100, facecolor="white")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# (a) NBI square matrix. Values below are approximate raster digitizations.
# Square area, not side length, encodes absolute normalized bias.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
models = ["Idefics2-8B", "InternVL2-8B", "LLaVA-OV-7B", "Mantis-8B",
          "Qwen2-VL-7B", "Gemini-1.5-Pro", "GPT-4o"]
nbi = np.array([
    [ 0.54, 0.24, 0.32, -0.40, 0.32, 0.39, 0.12],  # Video
    [ 0.78, 0.39, 0.33, -0.31, 0.65, 0.91, 0.22],  # Image
    [-0.61,-1.00, 0.09, -1.00,-0.04,-0.001,-0.18], # 3D
    [ 0.02, 0.06, 0.07, -0.05, 0.06, 0.53, 0.27], # Text
])
# Colours sampled from the centres of the approved raster's squares. This
# retains the reference palette rather than assigning estimated values an
# unjustified exact colour-to-NBI calibration.
rgb = np.array([
    [[226,158,157],[246,200,185],[239,187,174],[160,200,225],[239,187,174],[234,176,165],[252,220,207]],
    [[208,136,147],[235,177,166],[238,186,173],[176,211,230],[220,145,152],[188,130,144],[245,202,186]],
    [[147,183,215],[129,153,177],[252,232,221],[129,151,175],[233,242,247],[255,255,255],[202,226,238]],
    [[251,242,237],[253,235,225],[252,232,221],[232,241,248],[253,233,222],[227,159,158],[243,195,181]],
]) / 255.0
ax_a = fig.add_axes([76/1668, (518-326)/518, 440/1668, 254/518])
ax_a.set_xlim(0, 7); ax_a.set_ylim(4, 0)
for row in range(4):
    for col in range(7):
        ax_a.add_patch(Rectangle((col,row),1,1,facecolor="white",
                                edgecolor="#d4d4d4",linewidth=1.05))
        side = np.sqrt(abs(nbi[row,col])) * 0.98
        face = rgb[row,col]
        edge = np.clip(face * 0.91, 0, 1)
        ax_a.add_patch(Rectangle((col+.5-side/2,row+.5-side/2),side,side,
                                facecolor=face,edgecolor=edge,linewidth=0.7))
ax_a.set_xticks(np.arange(7)+.5, models, rotation=17, ha="center", fontsize=12)
ax_a.xaxis.tick_top(); ax_a.tick_params(axis="x",pad=5,length=5,width=1.1)
ax_a.set_yticks(np.arange(4)+.5,["Video-","Image-","3D -","Text -"],fontweight="bold",fontsize=14)
ax_a.tick_params(axis="y",length=0,pad=2)
for spine in ax_a.spines.values(): spine.set_visible(False)

audio_models = ["Qwen-Audio", "LTU", "AnyGPT", "OneLLM", "SALMONN-7B",
                "Gemini-Flash", "Qwen2-Audio"]
audio_nbi = np.array([1.0,-0.002,-0.12,-1.0,0.57,-0.36,1.0])  # estimates
audio_rgb = np.array([[181,128,144],[242,245,248],[211,231,240],[129,153,177],
                      [223,155,156],[176,211,230],[178,127,142]]) / 255.0
ax_audio = fig.add_axes([76/1668,(518-404)/518,440/1668,64/518])
ax_audio.set_xlim(0,7);ax_audio.set_ylim(1,0)
for col in range(7):
    ax_audio.add_patch(Rectangle((col,0),1,1,facecolor="white",edgecolor="#d4d4d4",linewidth=1.05))
    side=np.sqrt(abs(audio_nbi[col]))*.98
    ax_audio.add_patch(Rectangle((col+.5-side/2,.5-side/2),side,side,
                        facecolor=audio_rgb[col],edgecolor=audio_rgb[col]*.91,linewidth=.7))
ax_audio.set_xticks(np.arange(7)+.5,audio_models,rotation=17,ha="center",fontsize=12)
ax_audio.tick_params(axis="x",length=5,width=1.1,pad=5)
ax_audio.set_yticks([.5],["Audio -"],fontweight="bold",fontsize=14)
ax_audio.tick_params(axis="y",length=0,pad=1)
for spine in ax_audio.spines.values():spine.set_visible(False)

# Reference colour strip is reproduced directly from its sampled palette. It
# is a visual scale illustration, not extra evidence for the approximate NBI.
cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list("source_nbi_strip",
    ["#8ABBD9","#99B8D5","#A6AFCC","#B3A0BC","#BA92AD","#C17D96","#C2637B","#C55970"])
cax=fig.add_axes([533/1668,(518-399)/518,14/1668,322/518])
cb=fig.colorbar(ScalarMappable(norm=Normalize(-1,1),cmap=cmap),cax=cax)
cb.set_ticks([-1,-.6,-.2,.2,.6,1]);cb.set_ticklabels(["-1","-0.6","-0.2","0.2","0.6","1.0"])
cb.ax.tick_params(labelsize=12,length=0,pad=8);cb.outline.set_edgecolor("#b4b4b4");cb.outline.set_linewidth(.7)
fig.text(553/1668,1-62/518,"NBI",ha="center",va="center",fontweight="bold",fontsize=14)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# (b) Exact annotated bars with an approximate digitized difference curve.
# The reference's axis break is retained explicitly, not a claim that 36=0.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
types=["Scene","Animal","Person","Object","Document","Medical","Satellite"]
accuracy=np.array([78.9,89.3,85.4,92.2,73.5,57.6,63.6])  # exact Fig.5 labels
difference=np.array([1.8,-15.4,-4.8,-18.4,15.4,7.8,17.1])  # approximate pp
ax_b=fig.add_axes([664/1668,(518-404)/518,452/1668,332/518])
x=np.arange(7)
ax_b.bar(x,accuracy,width=.49,color="#EBD0A8",edgecolor="none")
ax_b.set_xlim(-.6,6.6);ax_b.set_ylim(36,100)
ax_b.set_xticks(x,types,rotation=20,ha="center",fontsize=13)
ax_b.set_yticks([36,40,50,60,70,80,90,100],["0","40","50","60","70","80","90","100"])
ax_b.tick_params(axis="y",labelsize=13,length=3,pad=2)
ax_b.tick_params(axis="x",length=0,pad=2)
ax_b.set_ylabel("Accuracy (%)",fontweight="bold",fontsize=17,labelpad=0)
ax_b.set_xlabel("Image Types",fontweight="bold",fontsize=15,labelpad=-2)
ax_b.spines["top"].set_visible(False);ax_b.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
ax_b.spines["left"].set_color("#888888");ax_b.spines["bottom"].set_color("#888888")
ax_b.yaxis.grid(True,ls=":",lw=.6,color="#cccccc");ax_b.set_axisbelow(True)
for xx,value in zip(x,accuracy):ax_b.text(xx,value+.35,f"{value:.1f}",ha="center",va="bottom",fontsize=6.3,color="#494949")
# Source-style lower-axis break marks. Bars extend below the visible segment.
for yy in [37.6,39.0]:
    ax_b.plot([-.67,-.57],[yy-.5,yy+.5],color="#666666",lw=.7,clip_on=False)
    ax_b.plot([-.55,-.45],[yy-.5,yy+.5],color="#666666",lw=.7,clip_on=False)
ax_diff=ax_b.twinx();ax_diff.set_ylim(-23,23)
ax_diff.plot(x,difference,"o--",color="#5874AA",lw=.9,markersize=3)
ax_diff.axhline(0,color="#888888",ls="--",lw=.65)
ax_diff.set_yticks([-20,-10,0,10,20]);ax_diff.tick_params(axis="y",labelsize=13,length=3,pad=3)
ax_diff.set_ylabel("Difference from Human (%)",fontweight="bold",fontsize=17,labelpad=3)
ax_diff.spines["top"].set_visible(False);ax_diff.spines["left"].set_visible(False)
ax_diff.spines["bottom"].set_visible(False);ax_diff.spines["right"].set_color("#888888")
fig.legend(handles=[Patch(facecolor="#EBD0A8",label="GPT-4o"),
                    Line2D([],[],color="#5874AA",marker="o",ls="--",lw=.9,markersize=3,

           loc="upper left",bbox_to_anchor=(680/1668,1-25/518),ncol=2,

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# (c) Human-relative radar. Table 2 exact accuracies in clockwise order:
# Text(S), Text(J), Video(J), Video(S), Image(J), Image(S), 3D(J), 3D(S),
# Audio(J), Audio(S). Here S denotes the selection/multiple-choice task.
# Human-relative normalization is inferred from the source plot's geometry.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
human=np.array([78.5,68.5,83.5,91.3,80.1,84.5,72.0,91.2,69.2,71.1])
radar_data={
    "Human":human.copy(),
    "LLaVA-OV-7B":np.array([48.4,53.0,56.8,59.8,49.8,51.7,68.4,53.8,np.nan,np.nan]),
    "Gemini-1.5-Pro":np.array([57.3,55.7,58.5,66.1,43.5,67.3,55.4,60.2,np.nan,np.nan]),
    "Claude-3.5":np.array([89.2,61.5,61.7,60.5,53.6,65.5,58.0,51.9,np.nan,np.nan]),
    "Mantis-8B":np.array([48.4,52.0,55.4,47.9,54.6,61.5,50.0,62.5,np.nan,np.nan]),
    "GPT-4o":np.array([66.6,55.9,71.3,77.3,63.4,80.8,65.2,70.2,np.nan,np.nan]),
    "InternVL2-8B":np.array([46.6,50.3,60.8,54.0,49.7,51.4,49.4,53.1,np.nan,np.nan]),
    "Qwen2-VL-7B":np.array([46.4,48.9,59.5,64.0,47.8,65.1,72.3,55.5,np.nan,np.nan]),
    "AnyGPT":np.array([np.nan]*8+[49.8,50.3]),
    "Gemini-Flash":np.array([np.nan]*8+[49.4,49.2]),
    "Qwen-Audio":np.array([np.nan]*8+[49.8,50.1]),
}
colors={"Human":"#FF927B","LLaVA-OV-7B":"#B4A2FF","Gemini-1.5-Pro":"#92D7F8",
        "AnyGPT":"#8ED900","Claude-3.5":"#35A4F8","Mantis-8B":"#F5A9AE",
        "GPT-4o":"#FFC500","Gemini-Flash":"#2483A5","InternVL2-8B":"#EB92C3",
        "Qwen2-VL-7B":"#65A45B","Qwen-Audio":"#FF4C27"}
ax_c=fig.add_axes([1184/1668,(518-470)/518,484/1668,470/518])
ax_c.set_xlim(1184,1668);ax_c.set_ylim(470,0);ax_c.axis("off")
cx,cy,r=1427,186,137
theta=np.arange(10)*2*np.pi/10
unit=np.column_stack([np.cos(theta),-np.sin(theta)])
for u in unit:ax_c.plot([cx,cx+151*u[0]],[cy,cy+151*u[1]],color="#dddddd",lw=.6,zorder=0)
for rr in [1.0]:ax_c.add_patch(Polygon(np.array([cx,cy])+unit*r*rr,closed=True,fill=False,edgecolor="#dddddd",lw=.6,zorder=0))

# The original radar visually separates its audio sector with narrow white
# gaps. Preserve that composition without treating unsupported audio as zero.
for name in ["Human","LLaVA-OV-7B","Gemini-1.5-Pro","Claude-3.5","Mantis-8B","GPT-4o","InternVL2-8B","Qwen2-VL-7B"]:
    rel=radar_data[name]/human
    if name=="Human":pts=np.array([cx,cy])+unit*r*rel[:,None]
    else:pts=np.array([cx,cy])+unit[:8]*r*rel[:8,None]
    ax_c.add_patch(Polygon(pts,closed=True,facecolor=colors[name],edgecolor=colors[name],alpha=.09,lw=.9,zorder=1))
    ax_c.plot(pts[:,0],pts[:,1],color=colors[name],lw=.8,alpha=.95,zorder=2)
    # Close between available axes, as in the reference. The connecting edge
    # is only a polygon boundary, not a measurement of unsupported audio.
    ax_c.plot([pts[-1,0],pts[0,0]],[pts[-1,1],pts[0,1]],color=colors[name],lw=.8,zorder=2)

for name in ["AnyGPT","Gemini-Flash","Qwen-Audio"]:
    rel=radar_data[name][8:]/human[8:]
    center=np.array([cx+7,cy+8])
    pts=np.vstack([center,center+unit[8]*r*rel[0],center+unit[9]*r*rel[1],center])
    # The source's separated audio insert has an opaque beige-grey interior;
    # keep it opaque so unavailable-modality closing edges do not show through.
    if name=="AnyGPT":
        ax_c.add_patch(Polygon(pts,closed=True,facecolor="#DCD4BF",edgecolor="none",zorder=3))
    ax_c.plot(pts[:,0],pts[:,1],color=colors[name],lw=.8,zorder=4)
# Reproduce the visible separated sector gaps rather than inventing a complete
# audio trajectory for image/video/text-only models.
for angle in [270,342]:
    aa=np.deg2rad(np.array([angle-5.3,angle+5.3]))
    pp=np.column_stack([np.cos(aa),-np.sin(aa)])*162+np.array([cx,cy])
    ax_c.add_patch(Polygon(np.vstack([[cx,cy],pp]),closed=True,facecolor="white",edgecolor="white",lw=0,zorder=5))
ax_c.add_patch(Arc((cx+7,cy+8),282,282,theta1=18,theta2=84,color="#c5c5c5",lw=.6,zorder=6))

label_pos=[("Text (S)",1593,186,"left"),("Text (J)",1552,85,"left"),
           ("Video (J)",1492,31,"center"),("Video (S)",1378,31,"center"),
           ("Image (J)",1298,85,"center"),("Image (S)",1266,186,"right"),
           ("3D (J)",1289,293,"right"),("3D (S)",1376,350,"center"),
           ("Audio (J)",1487,350,"center"),("Audio (S)",1578,299,"left")]
for t,xx,yy,ha in label_pos:ax_c.text(xx,yy,t,ha=ha,va="center",fontsize=14)

order=["Human","LLaVA-OV-7B","Gemini-1.5-Pro","AnyGPT","Claude-3.5","Mantis-8B","GPT-4o","Gemini-Flash","InternVL2-8B","Qwen2-VL-7B","Qwen-Audio"]
handles=[Patch(facecolor=colors[n]+"20",edgecolor=colors[n],linewidth=.8,label=n) for n in order]
fig.legend(handles=handles,ncol=3,frameon=False,fontsize=12,
           loc="upper left",bbox_to_anchor=(1218/1668,1-369/518),
           handlelength=1.3,handletextpad=.6,columnspacing=.7,labelspacing=.25,borderaxespad=0)
for xx,t in [(291,"(a)"),(890,"(b)"),(1422,"(c)")]:
    fig.text(xx/1668,1-485/518,t,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=20)

fig.savefig("loki_model_capability_assessment.png",dpi=150)
fig.savefig("loki_model_capability_assessment.svg")
plt.show()
```

### Plotting Code

All news/publication values below are transcribed from the figure’s printed annotations; typography and spacing are a visual reconstruction.

```python
"""LOKI Figure 8: values transcribed exactly from printed point annotations."""
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "DejaVu Sans",
    "font.size": 10,
    "axes.linewidth": 0.8,
    "xtick.major.size": 3,
    "ytick.major.size": 3,
})
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6.2), dpi=150, facecolor="white")
left = fig.add_axes([0.055, 0.215, 0.39, 0.75])
right = fig.add_axes([0.61, 0.215, 0.375, 0.75])

# Exact printed numbers, not estimated experimental measurements.
news_years = np.arange(2018, 2025)
news_counts = np.array([0, 1, 3, 11, 8, 18, 24])
publication_years = np.arange(2018, 2024)
publication_counts = np.array([45, 247, 895, 1653, 2739, 3014])

for ax, years, counts in [
    (left, news_years, news_counts),
    (right, publication_years, publication_counts),
]:
    ax.plot(years, counts, color="#1F77B4", marker="o", markersize=5.2, linewidth=1.8)
    ax.set_xticks(years)
    ax.set_xlim(years[0] - 0.3, years[-1] + 0.3)
    ax.set_xlabel("Year")
    ax.grid(True, color="#B0B0B0", linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.8)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    for year, count in zip(years, counts):
        ax.annotate(str(count), (year, count), xytext=(0, 6), textcoords="offset points",
                    ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=10, color="#111111")
left.set_ylim(0, 28)
left.set_yticks(np.arange(0, 26, 5))
left.set_ylabel("News Count of Deepfake Topic (total)")
right.set_ylim(0, 3500)
right.set_yticks(np.arange(0, 3501, 500))
right.set_ylabel("Publications Count of Deepfake Detection (total)")

# These two lines are the original internal panel descriptions.
fig.text(0.01, 0.10,
         "(a) The number of BBC official news reports on\n"
         "deepfake topic over the years.",
         ha="left", va="top", fontfamily="serif", fontsize=15, linespacing=1.15)
fig.text(0.555, 0.10,
         "(b) The number of publications on deepfake de-\n"
         "tection over the years.(From Gong & Li (2024))",
         ha="left", va="top", fontfamily="serif", fontsize=15, linespacing=1.15)

# Geometry/font metrics are reconstructed; all 13 numerical values above are exact.
plt.show()
```
